pages.title: All Aboard!
pages.text: Assemble a nonempty train and drive it between two distinct stations.

pages.title: All Aboard!
pages.text: Turn railway parts into an actual journey.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Assemble the train at a station with valid bogeys and controls. Drive it to another native station and stop there. No minimum route distance is imposed.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Enter Station assembly mode, place bogeys with Train Casing, glue carriage blocks and include Train Controls. Confirm assembly to create a train; disassembly is performed at stations.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use Train Controls, movement keys and mouse-wheel speed adjustment; hold Space when approaching a station. Drive and berth the train using native controls.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Open the native Bogey Menu while placing Train Casing and select a style compatible with the track gauge. Choose gauge-aware bogeys; Phantom Tracks accept all bogey types and are revealed while held.
